review.exactIdentity: Two agents compared the original ATEHNA070112 photo directly with the already accepted65108 source. Same red moulded body, front hinged compartment and seams, pan platforms, deep grey pans, grey pointed adjustment/pointer component and red top paddle; only compartment position and demonstration loads differ. Source SKU070112 maps to the bare plastic scale, not grey070110.
review.accessories: Live ATEHNA WooCommerce variation_description specifically says weights are NOT included for070112 and ARE included for65108. Coloured cubes are demonstration props, not included in manufacturer LER2420 package; live070112 does not claim cubes included. Caption valid for BOTH variants explicitly limits brass-weight inclusion to the variant named plastic-with-weights and excludes coloured cubes.
review.quality: Original1800×1800 JPEG from untransformed Walmart asr source URL. Full photograph and native detail reviewed independently by two agents. Moderate grain/compression remains, but body contours, removable pans, pointer and weight compartment retain useful detail and full framing. No evidence of enlargement found; no new scaling, cropping or padding applied. Acceptable photograph, not pristine studio quality.
review.sourceDataCaution: The historical source snapshot copied the family description into every variant. Fresh live variation-specific descriptions correct that ambiguity. Existing Wissner family branding conflict remains a separate catalog-data issue; no product specifications, prices or statuses changed.
